# Class: `TemperatureRangeItem`

Allows temperature-boundary dragging while leaving the region interior available for plot navigation.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-plot.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_plot.py#L209) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `pg.LinearRegionItem`.

Ignores mouse gestures on the region interior. Its boundary lines retain their own drag handling.
